I have designed and built the **GeoLens — Prompt Research** screen matching your exact brand system and product chrome specs.

### Design Details:
1. **Brand System & Consistency (`Precision Geospatial Analytics`)**:
   - **Colors**: Accent teal `#0F766E`, clean white panels (`#FFFFFF`), soft mint/gray background wash (`#F5F7F8`), dark ink typography (`#0B1218`), muted metadata (`#5C6B76`), and clean light borders (`#E3E9ED`). No purple, no emojis, purely professional B2B analytics.
   - **Typography & Radius**: Plus Jakarta Sans with refined hierarchy and 12–16px container radius.

2. **App Chrome & Context**:
   - **Top Bar**: Workspace selector (`Attio · Demo`), date range controls (`Last 7 days`, `Last 30 days`), model selector (`All Models / 4 AI Engines`), trial status, report export, and primary teal CTA (`New Analysis`).
   - **Left Secondary Navigation**: Under the `AI Analysis` group, **Prompt Research** is rendered in its active state (teal badge and white icon/text), with links for Visibility Overview, Competitor Research, Brand Performance, and Boost & Monitor sections plus real-time quota telemetry.

3. **Prompt Research Discovery Workspace**:
   - **Top KPI Ribbon**: Identified Buyer Prompts (384), High-Volume Inquiries (126), Currently Active Tracking (68), and Uncovered Opportunity Gaps (42).
   - **Research Controls & Toolbar**: Prompt search bar, dropdown filters for Volume (1–5★), Search Intent (Commercial, Technical, Comparative), Branding (Non-Branded vs. Attio Branded), and an AI prompt generation CTA (`Generate Prompts`).
   - **Topic Filter Chips**: Quick filtering across *All Topics (384)*, *Startup & Early Stage*, *Modern Relational CRM*, *HubSpot Alternatives*, and *API & Developer First*.
   - **Dense Data Table**: Rows with interactive multi-select checkboxes, prompt text with top-cited AI platforms, topic badges, intent pills, branding indicators, volume star ratings (1–5), coverage status pills (`Active Tracking`, `Suggested Gap`, `Critical Deficit`), and quick action buttons.
   - **Batch Action Footer**: Multi-selection summary (`3 prompts selected`), with prominent `Activate Selected` and `Export CSV` buttons alongside standard pagination.

4. **Right Panel — Coverage Overview & Starter Pack**:
   - **Coverage Overview**: Stacked progress bar showing the activation rate (17.7% active, 48.2% suggested gaps, 34.1% unreviewed), plus breakdowns by topic cluster, buyer persona (Founders, RevOps, Engineers, Agencies), and geographical benchmark.
   - **Suggested Starter Prompts (CRM / Attio Demo)**: Curated high-intent prompts targeting common AI buyer inquiries with one-click `Add to Track` and bulk import capabilities.
